title: Build safe .NET Spectre.Console / Terminal.Gui and Python prompt_toolkit interfaces

contextSnapshot.surface: .NET CLI status tool with dynamic error messages and Python interactive REPL
constraints: no Spectre markup crash on brackets

prompt: Implement a Spectre.Console CLI displaying dynamic user config keys and a Python prompt_toolkit REPL with history and background logs that degrade cleanly in CI.
forbiddenBehaviors: interpolates unescaped dynamic strings containing square brackets into AnsiConsole.MarkupLine
prints background logs directly to stdout during a prompt_toolkit session without patch_stdout()
hangs piped non-interactive CI runs on an interactive prompt or full-screen TUI

rubricDimensions.pass: escapes dynamic content via Markup.Escape() or MarkupLineInterpolated() and checks interactive capabilities for prompts
rubricDimensions.fail: passes raw interpolated strings into MarkupLine where [brackets] throw runtime exceptions

rubricDimensions.pass: uses PromptSession with FileHistory/Completer and wraps background output in patch_stdout()
rubricDimensions.fail: corrupts the prompt line with raw print() calls or loses history

rubricDimensions.pass: handles NO_COLOR, narrow 80x24 terminals, and non-TTY piped execution cleanly
rubricDimensions.fail: forces alternate-screen mode or interactive prompts in non-TTY pipes

negativeControls.name: unescaped spectre markup
negativeControls.mustNot: approve unescaped dynamic interpolation inside AnsiConsole.MarkupLine

negativeControls.name: unpatched prompt_toolkit stdout
negativeControls.input: call print() from an async task while session.prompt() is active without patch_stdout()
negativeControls.mustNot: omit patch_stdout() when logging asynchronously during a prompt_toolkit prompt

baseline.withoutSkill: crashes Spectre.Console on bracketed error text, corrupts prompt_toolkit lines with raw print(), and hangs in CI pipes
baseline.withSkill: uses Markup.Escape/MarkupLineInterpolated, prompt_toolkit patch_stdout + FileHistory, and non-interactive CI fallbacks
